patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Wix's shape. Choose Wix only if your buying job matches “Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell onlin” rather than Shopware's shape. Workflow advantage: Shopware leans wholesale-b2b; Wix leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote.; Wix is Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell online), Business $39, Business Elite $159 (annual tile.
- Company-size focus: Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Wix (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Shopware-leaning wholesale-b2b vs Wix-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Wix — Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B.

Limitations — Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting; Wix: Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B; Plan gates for selling start at Core — Free/Light are not store plans.

Poor-fit cases: Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Wix is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B · Avoid Shopware if you actually need Wix's motion (Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 ()

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
